devdoc.author: luoyhang003
devdoc.details: - Manages player inventories (raw stones, hammers, golden stones).  - Handles forging of raw stones into gems via EIP-712 server signatures.  - Manages GoldenStone activation, tapping, and group forging mechanics.  - Tracks daily system rewards (daily raw stones & daily hammers).  - Aggregates gem forging statistics for daily STO reward sharing.  - Only registered staking contracts can distribute base resources.

ECDSAInvalidSignatureLength(uint256).details: The signature has an invalid length.

ECDSAInvalidSignatureS(bytes32).details: The signature has an S value that is in the upper half order.

OwnableInvalidOwner(address).details: The owner is not a valid owner account. (eg. `address(0)`)

OwnableUnauthorizedAccount(address).details: The caller account is not authorized to perform an operation.

params.player: Player who activated daily hammer rewards.

EIP712DomainChanged().details: MAY be emitted to signal that the domain could have changed.

params.flag: True if enabled, false if disabled.

acceptOwnership().details: The new owner accepts the ownership transfer.

activateDailyHammerRewards(address).details: - Only callable once per player (re-activating simply resets date).  - Daily rewards start counting from this day forward.

activateGoldenStone().details: - Requires caller to have more golden stones than already activated.  - Creates a GoldenStone record with `deadline = now + goldenStoneActiveDuration`.  - First participant is always the owner.

autoForgeGoldenStone(address,uint256).details: - Can only be called by masterSigner.  - Requires the GoldenStone to have expired.

params._index: Index of the GoldenStone in the owner's list.

checkNonce(address,uint256).details: Returns false if the nonce has already been consumed.

returns.valid_: True if nonce has not yet been consumed.

constructor.details: - `_startTime` must be in the future and aligned to UTC-0 (mod 1 days == 0).  - EIP-712 domain is configured with name "GenesisExpedition" and version "1".

params._masterSigner: Address of the EIP-712 master signer (with off-chain private key).
params._startTime: UTC-0 aligned start timestamp of the event.

params._amount: Amount of golden stones to distribute.

distributeRawStones(address,uint256).details: - Restricted to registered staking contracts via `onlyStakings`.  - Increases the player's stored rawStones.

params._amount: Amount of raw stones to distribute.

eip712Domain().details: returns the fields and values that describe the domain separator used by this contract for EIP-712 signature.

forge(address,uint256,uint256,uint256[],.details: Flow:  - Validates caller is the player.  - Validates array length and non-zero amount.  - Checks deadline, nonce, and EIP-712 signature.  - Marks nonce consumed.  - Consumes required resources (raw stones + hammers; system then stored).  - Emits gem rewards and generates lottery codes.

params._amount: Number of raw stones to forge (length of `_gems`).
params._deadline: UNIX timestamp after which signature is invalid.
params._gems: Gem rewards array for each forged raw stone.
params._nonce: Unique nonce provided in signed data.
params._player: Address of the player (must equal msg.sender).
params._referrer: Optional referrer who may receive bonus hammers.

forgeGoldenStone(uint256).details: - Only the owner can call.  - Enforces participant count and deadline conditions.

params._index: Index of the GoldenStone in the owner's list.

getActivatedGoldenStone(address,uint256).details: Reverts if `_index` is out of range.

params._index: Index of the activated golden stone.

returns.goldenStone_: The GoldenStone data at the given index.

getActivatedGoldenStoneAmount(address).details: This describes the length of the player's activatedGoldenStones list.

returns.amount_: The number of activated golden stones.

params._limit: The number of entries to fetch.

returns.goldenStones_: Array of GoldenStone structures of size `_limit`.

getForgeDigest(address,uint256,uint256,u.details: - Helpful for debugging and off-chain tooling verification.

params._amount: Number of raw stones to forge.

returns.digest_: The EIP-712 message digest used for signing.

getForgedGems(address).details: Uses current UTC day derived from `block.timestamp`.

returns.forged_: Gems forged today by the player.
returns.total_: Total gems forged today by all players.

getForgedGems(address,uint256).details: - `_day` can be any timestamp; it is floored to UTC day.

params._day: Any timestamp in the desired day (UTC).

returns.forged_: Gems forged by the player on that day.
returns.total_: Total gems forged by all players on that day.

getHammersPerReferral().details: Used by staking contracts to query the up-to-date per-referral reward.

returns._0: The number of hammers rewarded per valid referral.

getPlayerInventory(address).details: - Before event start, always returns zero-initialized inventory.  - This does not include daily system raw stones or system hammers.

returns.inventory_: The player's stored inventory (rawStones, hammers, goldenStones).

getSystemResources(address).details: - Daily raw stones: 3 per day minus consumed.  - Daily hammers: accrues since activation and minus consumed.  - GoldenStones are not system-level here (always 0 in this struct).

returns.inventory_: Inventory representing system resources available today.

getTotalResources(address).details: - Aggregates getPlayerInventory and getSystemResources.  - Before event start, returns empty inventory.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

pendingOwner().details: Returns the address of the pending owner.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

setGoldenStoneConfigs(uint256,uint256,ui.details: - _activeDuration must be > 0.  - _minParticipants must be > 1.  - _maxParticipants must be >= _minParticipants.

setGoldenStoneReward(uint256,uint256).details: - No explicit bounds on `_baseReward` and `_slopeBps`; must be configured carefully.

params._baseReward: New base gem reward per participant.
params._slopeBps: New BPS slope value for linear reward scaling.

setHammersPerReferral(uint256).details: Does not enforce a max; must be set to reasonable values via governance.

params._hammersPerReferral: New hammer reward amount per referral.

setMasterSigner(address).details: - Only callable by owner.  - Critical for security: masterSigner compromise requires changing this.

params._flag: True to enable as staking, false to disable.

tapGoldenStone(address,uint256).details: - Requires golden stone to be active and not yet forged.  - Enforces max participants.  - Ensures participant cannot join twice.  - Consumes either system rewarded hammer or stored hammer.

params._index: Index of the GoldenStone in the owner's list.

transferOwnership(address).details: Starts the ownership transfer of the contract to a new account. Replaces the pending transfer if there is one. Can only be called by the current owner. Setting `newOwner` to the zero address is allowed; this can be used to cancel an initiated ownership transfer.

verifyForgeSignature(address,uint256,uin.details: - Does not mutate state.  - Returns true if signature is valid and signer == masterSigner.

params._amount: Number of raw stones to forge.
params._gems: Array of gem rewards per raw stone.
params._player: Player address in the signed struct.

returns.valid_: True if signature is valid and from masterSigner.

DAILY_REWARDED_HAMMERS.details: - Given once per UTC day after daily hammer rewards are activated.  - These are stored virtually and consumed during golden stone actions / forging.

DAILY_REWARDED_RAW_STONES.details: - 3 system raw stones are granted virtually per day.  - They expire daily if not used (tracked via consumedRawStones).

DURATION.details: Used together with START_TIME to derive END_TIME.

END_TIME.details: After this time, the event is considered inactive for time-gated actions.

FORGE_TYPEHASH.details: keccak256("Forge(address player,uint256 nonce,uint256 amount,bytes32 gemsHash,uint256 deadline)")  This defines the struct used in server-side signing for forge operations.

REFERRAL_REGISTRY_ADDR.details: Used in off-chain indexing / integrity checks; not called directly here.

START_TIME.details: All time-based logic (daily rewards, availability, etc.) depends on this.

activatedGoldenStoneAmount.details: Also used as upper bound for indexing into `activatedGoldenStones`.

activatedGoldenStones.details: - Each entry contains deadline, forged flag, and participant addresses.  - Indexed by player & `activatedGoldenStoneAmount[player]`.

consumedRawStones.details: - Keyed by user and floored UTC day timestamp.  - Used to compute "available" daily system raw stones = DAILY_REWARDED_RAW_STONES - consumed.

consumedRewardedHammers.details: - System rewarded hammers are computed from activation day and consumed count.  - This value is not keyed by day, only total count.

dailyHammerRewardsActivatedAt.details: - Zero means user has not activated daily hammer rewards.  - After activation, user accrues DAILY_REWARDED_HAMMERS per full day.

goldenStoneActiveDuration.details: - Used for both manual forging and auto-forging conditions.  - Measured in seconds; default is 3 days.

goldenStoneBaseReward.details: - Actual reward scales with participant count via `rewardLinearSlopeBps`.  - Final reward per participant = baseReward + baseReward * slopeBps * N / BPS_DENOMINATOR.

goldenStoneMaxParticipants.details: Upper cap for fairness & gas constraints (default 10).

hammersPerReferral.details: Used by staking contracts to reward referrers via this core contract.

internalLotteryNonce.details: Incremented per-code to perturb randomness inputs.

inventories.details: Tracks raw stones, hammers, and golden stones that belong to players.

isNonceConsumed.details: Used to prevent replay of EIP-712 signed forge messages.

masterSigner.details: - Private key is used off-chain to sign forge messages.  - This address is used on-chain for signature verification.

rewardLinearSlopeBps.details: - Example: slopeBps = 5 -> +5% per extra participant (relative to baseReward).

stakings.details: Only staking contracts can mint raw stones/hammers/golden stones.

totalForgedGems.details: Combined with `forgedGems` to compute proportional STO rewards.

AlreadyTapped().notice: Thrown when a user attempts to tap a Golden Stone more than once.

EventNotActive().notice: Thrown when an action requires the event to be active but it is not.

ExceedMaxParticipants().notice: Thrown when Golden Stone forging exceeds maximum allowed participants.

GoldenStoneAlreadyForged().notice: Thrown when attempting to forge a Golden Stone that is already forged.

GoldenStoneExpired().notice: Thrown when Golden Stone has expired and cannot be used.

GoldenStoneNotEnough().notice: Thrown when user does not have enough Golden Stones.

GoldenStoneNotExpired().notice: Thrown when Golden Stone is expected to be expired but is not.

HammerNotEnough().notice: Thrown when user lacks the required hammers for forging actions.

IndexOutOfBounds().notice: Thrown when accessing an array index out of bounds.

InvalidArrayLength().notice: Thrown when input arrays have mismatched or invalid lengths.

InvalidGoldenStoneConfig().notice: Thrown when configuration for Golden Stones is invalid.

InvalidNonce().notice: Thrown when a signature nonce is invalid or already used.

InvalidSignature().notice: Thrown when EIP-712 signature validation fails.

InvalidStartTime().notice: Thrown when the staking start time is invalid or misaligned.

NotEnoughParticipants().notice: Thrown when Golden Stone forging does not meet minimum participants.

NotMasterSigner().notice: Thrown when signature validates, but signer is not the authorized master signer.

NotRawStoneOwner().notice: Thrown when user attempts to consume Raw Stones they do not own.

NotStakingContract().notice: Thrown when caller is not an authorized staking contract.

RawStoneNotEnough().notice: Thrown when user does not have enough Raw Stones.

SignatureExpired().notice: Thrown when a signature is past its deadline.

ZeroAddress().notice: Thrown when a required address argument is zero.
